name: Abijah
bio: Abijah was Samuel's second son. When Samuel grew old, he appointed Abijah and his older brother Joel as judges over Israel at Beersheba; but they did not walk in their father's ways, turning aside after dishonest gain, taking bribes, and perverting justice. This led the elders of Israel to come to Samuel and demand a king to govern them like the other nations (1 Samuel 8:1-5). Abijah and his brother's corruption directly triggered this pivotal turn in Israel's history toward kingship.
